rows.en: <operator(21010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Eureka<ce()>'s really gone and done something bold...
<operator(21030,1)><speed(2)>A girl can get pretty bold for the person she likes, you know.
<operator(21030,1)><speed(2)>Though that's probably hard for you to get, <color(4)>Gainer<ce()>.
<operator(21020,1)><speed(2)>I'm worried about where <color(4)>Renton<ce()> ended up too.
<operator(21020,1)><speed(2)>Kid or not, as a member of <color(4)>Gekkostate<ce()> he's got a bounty on his head now.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>The <color(6)>Swan<ce()>... Never thought I'd run into <color(5)>Charles<ce()> and <color(5)>Ray<ce()> out here...
rows.notes: White Swan-go = the SL-1200 MkI 'Swan', Charles and Ray Beams's ship; see glossary_proposals.

rows.en: <operator(23040,1)><speed(2)>I heard those two went freelance after leaving the military...
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>What were those two like?
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)><color(5)>Charles<ce()> used to be in the same SOF unit as me. We fought together.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>Usually a cheerful guy, but his LFO piloting sense was a cut above.
<operator(23040,1)><speed(2)><color(5)>Charles<ce()>'s wife <color(5)>Ray<ce()> was a former intel officer, a colleague of mine.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>I didn't want to fight them, but if they stand in our way, I won't hold back...
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>But... <color(4)>Eureka<ce()>. You care that much about <color(4)>Renton<ce()>...
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>Are you saying you chose him?
<operator(23040,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Holland<ce()>... admit it already.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>I know... I know it already.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>But it's not easy to simply admit it...
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)>A new power for us is waiting on that island.
<operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>Yeah, if I'm not mistaken, what's on that island is...
<operator(17030,1)><speed(2)>What are you two talking about?
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>Microwave power came down on that island.
<operator(17020,1)><speed(2)>Don't tell me, it's <color(4)>GX<ce()>...!
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Faye<ce()>, about before...
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>I really... after all...
rows.notes: Source is Barrel's trailing, unfinished thought ('boku wa yappari...'); what he means to say is not settled before Faye cuts him off. Kept open.

rows.en: <operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>Wait, <color(4)>Barrel<ce()>. You don't need to say it now.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Why not?
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>I want you focused on the fight. Your safety comes first right now.
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>Don't feel anxious. I'll be right there supporting you.
<operator(1040,2)><speed(2)>...Thanks.
<operator(25020,1)><speed(2)>The enemy's <color(5)>military base<ce()>... Their defenses look thick.
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>Yeah, but we've got to carve a way through, for <color(4)>Renton<ce()> and <color(4)>Eureka<ce()>'s sake.
<operator(21030,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Gainer<ce()>, please make sure you find <color(4)>Eureka<ce()>.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>Isn't that <color(4)>Renton<ce()>'s duty, though?
<operator(21020,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Gainer<ce()>, I get why <color(4)>Renton<ce()> leaving made you angry, but try to understand how he feels too.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>I'm angry because I do understand how he feels. <color(4)>Renton<ce()>... what are you doing.
<operator(1020,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Faye<ce()>, be careful. <color(4)>Barrel<ce()> too... it's dangerous out there.
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>Yes, I know.
<operator(1020,1)><speed(2)>Abandoning the fight, huh. Can't be helped with so many young ones around.
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>If only I were a little more put together...
<operator(1020,2)><speed(2)>You're doing fine. But the two of you are one unit, so look out for him.
<operator(1020,2)><speed(2)>It's hard now, but a day will come when you're glad you fought together.
<operator(23040,1)><speed(2)>Sorry our kids are causing trouble.
<operator(6011,1)><speed(2)>It's fine. The moment you doubt yourself, even a little, you can't fight anymore.
<operator(6011,1)><speed(2)>I've had times like that too.
<operator(23100,1)><speed(2)>R-really? You sure don't look like it...
<operator(6011,1)><speed(2)>I found something to anchor myself to... They need that too.
<operator(19060,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Ryoma<ce()>... Please put <color(4)>Eureka<ce()> first.
<operator(19060,1)><speed(2)>I've got <color(4)>Kei<ce()>, after all. This doesn't feel like someone else's problem.
<operator(19040,1)><speed(2)>...Fine. Can't say no when you make a face like that.
